tools.name: quant_decision
tools.description: Evidence-gated equity decision workspace: actual daily/hourly bars, WAIT/SETUP reasons, observed structure and input receipt. Uses the full-terminal x402 price; call x402_contract for current terms. No order execution or profit probability.

tools.name: x402_contract
tools.description: Free. Prices, payTo, network and URLs for the x402-paid quant tools and endpoints (USDC on Base). Paid tools: call without payment to get HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, retry the same call with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

tools.name: quant_snapshot
tools.description: PAID tool ($0.02 USDC via x402, Base). Live quote, completed-session levels (20-day ceiling/floor, ATR, SMAs, pivots, 52-week range, relative volume) and a two-source price cross-check for a US ticker. Real data from Tradier, Massive/Polygon and Alpaca.

tools.name: mirror_projection
tools.description: PAID tool ($0.05 USDC via x402, Base). Walk a ticker's latest close forward through the real session-by-session returns of a past window (for example AMC from 2021-01-22). Returns every projected session with the real historical bar it mirrors. A hypothetical analog, not a forecast.

tools.name: analog_scan
tools.description: PAID tool ($0.05 USDC via x402, Base). Find the past windows whose daily return shape best matches the latest window (Pearson correlation) and report what actually happened 5, 10 and 20 sessions later.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: x402_contract · Public sink: mirror_projection.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: x402_contract · Public sink: mirror_projection

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
